subject: Private deployment PT: scope validation & remediation timeline
messages:
From: Alice Melton <alice.melton@acmecloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: PT artifacts & scope clarification for AcmeCloud private deployment

Marcus / team —

Thanks for taking this on. AcmeCloud is preparing a final compliance package for our regulator and we need the penetration test artifacts for the private deployment you manage: specifically we want:

- The final RedTeam report (full findings, risk ratings, and technical appendices) for the engagement run against our project "acme-prod"
- A clear statement of boundary assumptions (what is in-scope vs out-of-scope for tenant isolation, NAT/egress, VPC peering)
- Evidence that the high/critical findings from the June engagement were remediated (screenshots, ticket IDs, patch dates)
- Confirmation whether the assessment was credentialed (host-level) or black-box only, and whether cloud-managed components (shared load balancers, cloud DNS) were considered in-scope

We have two internal ticket refs for the regulator: ACME-Sec-1121 and ACME-Sec-1130. Please include any artifacts that map to those. If you can bundle a single evidence archive and a short one-page summary of the scope assumptions that will help our compliance team.

Do you have an ETA for when we can get the bundle? Also propose a 30-minute call this week to walk through any questions.

Appreciate it —

--
Alice Melton
Security Compliance Manager
AcmeCloud

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Melton <alice.melton@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT artifacts & scope clarification for AcmeCloud private deployment

Alice —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the bundle and a one-page scope summary. To set expectations up front, our assumptions for the AcmeCloud private deployment assessment were: 

- Deployment model: customer-managed VPC with Redwood-managed inference instances running in the customer project (project id: acme-prod).
- Network boundary: we tested tenant isolation within the customer VPC and egress paths from inference hosts to customer-managed NAT gateways; Redwood control-plane services are out-of-scope.
- Supported components in-scope: inference instances, instance metadata/configuration, container runtime on the customer-hosted instances, and the application-level listener ports. Cloud-managed platform services (shared VPC control plane, managed DNS) were considered out-of-scope unless explicit peering exposed them.
- Assessment type: hybrid (credentialed agent deployed to a limited set of hosts to validate privilege escalation plus external red-team tasks).

I will attach a short PDF that lists the assumptions and mapping to the regulator questions: vpc-segmentation-assumptions.pdf (attached). We will also include the RedTeamOps report and a remediation log.

Proposed next steps:
- I will assemble the evidence bundle and upload to a shared Drive link (target: 48 hours).
- Schedule a 30-minute call Wednesday 8/4 10:00–10:30 PT to walk through the findings and remediation status; Lauren and Karthik will join to cover ops and remediation details.

If any of the assumptions above are inconsistent with what you expect, let me know and we will adjust the scope statement before we hand it over to your regulator.

Regards,

--
Marcus Lin
Account Security Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Melton <alice.melton@acmecloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT artifacts & scope clarification for AcmeCloud private deployment

Marcus —

Thanks, that helps. A couple quick clarifying questions before your upload:

1) For the hybrid credentialed portion, can you confirm the agent footprint and that no persistent credentials remain on hosts post-test? We need assurance that the test agent was removed and that final images are restored.
2) Regarding cloud-managed components: please confirm whether the shared VPC control plane endpoints were tested or explicitly excluded. The regulator flagged a potential path via a misconfigured shared balancer in our earlier assessment — if you tested it, call that out in the scope summary; if not, confirm exclusion and the reason.
3) For the two high-risk items (ACME-Sec-1121, ACME-Sec-1130) we need the remediation dates and ticket references to our JIRA (ACMEJIRA-5582, ACMEJIRA-5589).

If you can add short screenshots or ticket exports proving the fixes that will speed sign-off. If you need a different call time, we can be flexible.

Best —
Alice

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Melton <alice.melton@acmecloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT artifacts & scope clarification for AcmeCloud private deployment

Alice / team —

Following up with the remediation status for the two items you flagged:

- ACME-Sec-1121 (publicly accessible management port discovered): Resolved 2027-07-28. Security group tightened, NAT route reviewed. JIRA: ACMEJIRA-5582. Evidence: remediation-log-20270803.csv (attached) contains ticket export and confirmation.
- ACME-Sec-1130 (insecure container runtime configuration): Mitigated via image rebuild and runtime hardening. Patches applied 2027-07-30; scheduled follow-up patch window for the container orchestration control-plane on 2027-08-10. JIRA: ACMEJIRA-5589. Evidence: isolation-matrix.xlsx attached, contains before/after configuration snapshots and host-level patch timestamps.

Credentialed agent notes: we deployed a short-lived audit agent to two hosts only; it removed itself at the end of the engagement. We will include the agent removal logs in the bundle.

I will upload the artifacts to the Drive link Marcus shares and confirm when complete.

Thanks,

--
Karthik Iyer
Security Engineer, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Melton <alice.melton@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT artifacts & scope clarification for AcmeCloud private deployment

Alice —

Evidence bundle has been uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/AcmeCloud/PT-evidence-2027-08 (link below). Contents: 
- vpc-pt-report-redteamops.pdf (full RedTeamOps report)
- vpc-segmentation-assumptions.pdf (one-page scope summary)
- remediation-log-20270803.csv (ticket export & timestamps)
- isolation-matrix.xlsx (configuration snapshots + host patch times)
- agent-removal.log (agent uninstall confirmation)

Call: happy to keep the Wednesday 8/4 slot if you still prefer that; alternate 8/6 09:00–09:30 PT also open.

Notes: we confirmed that shared control-plane endpoints were not exercised during the engagement because they are not reachable from the customer subnet by default; this is documented in the scope summary. If AcmeCloud wants a follow-up run that specifically tests shared platform components, we can schedule a separate scoped assessment (would require an addendum).

If you want, I can deliver a brief cover letter for the regulator that ties each artifact to the relevant SOC/SIG question numbers — happy to do that as a follow-up.

Best regards,

--
Marcus Lin
Account Security Lead
Redwood Inference
